question: Can documented native Tab focus and one macOS paste establish a usable constructor-name route?
scope: New independent focus/paste calibration only. P001 and old 001/002/003 cases remain closed with their original outcomes.
P001 established no product defect or cause; Winit installed default accepts_first_mouse=true, so no first-click explanation is assumed.
No source, Cargo, Git, evaluator or old-case edits; no compilation cache copied.
No reference, release, physics, offset or full workflow acceptance.
pre_clock: Require ROOT GO bound to proposal hash and confirmation root-owned publication xtask 35392 finished.
Initialize CUA using only getState first if needed; read returned native API documentation. No selected app or screenshot.

Initialize one declared persistent n002 state object and recorder with a no-UI selfcheck, using explicit variable declarations. Confirm documented pressKey, paste, full AX, screenshot and close APIs before timed launch.
Rerun read-only source87, candidate clean commit, binary/bundle, plan/proposal checks and exact-owned-executable absence. Stop on mismatch.

launch.clock: UTC and monotonic start recorded immediately before the only open invocation.
launch.ownership: Before cua.getApp, independently prove exactly one newly created PID with actual executable/full argv equal to this bundle Contents/MacOS/weftforge and persist process/OWNED-PID-PROOF.json.

steps.action: Bind only the proven unique app ID, then observe fresh full AX plus real own-window screenshot.
steps.require: Actual own clean window, rev 0, 0 pieces, no Unsaved marker. Record initial focus. Missing full revision/piece/focus evidence is a stop, not a guessed pass.

steps.action: Press only Tab then obtain fresh full AX after each, at most 40 times. Record each actual focused AX line, exact field value, revision and piece count.
steps.exit_when: The actual focused UI element is a text field whose exact current value is Pattern 1; field presence alone is insufficient.
steps.require: At every step rev 0, 0 pieces and no Unsaved marker remain unchanged. No pointer focus, typeText, setValue, shortcut variation, reverse navigation or retries.
steps.stop: First unexpected state, missing focus/revision evidence, loop limit or wall budget. Retain second real own-app image, then cleanup.

steps.only_if: N2 actual focus and value proved.
action: Exactly one app.paste(Studio preview, {format: text}) using the documented text API
Immediate full AX before any blur; require exact constructor field value Studio preview and rev 0 / 0 pieces
Fresh full AX plus real own-app screenshot; require exact constructor value Studio preview again and rev 0 / 0 pieces before any Add
steps.stop: Any mismatch ends calibration with no fallback, second paste, alternative input path or Add.

steps.only_if: N3 exact value verified before and after Tab.
action: Click Add rectangle once using its fresh current AX button identity, leaving all dimensions/coordinates at defaults
Observe full AX for the actual single Studio preview piece, accepted rest mesh and selected Scene row; bounded reads only, no additional authoring
Only if framing is needed, use the freshly observed Frame all button once
Capture the actual selected Properties and Scene in the third real own-app screenshot
steps.require: Actual accepted one-piece/rest-mesh state; implementation tests do not establish runtime success.

steps.action: Close only the owned preview by its documented and observed native close route. If dirty, observe and activate Discard and close. Observe final dismissal; if no close route is exposed, stop CUA at that actual observed outcome.
steps.summary_order: The very next tool call after final observed CUA outcome MUST be mcp__cua_repl.js with only completion_summary exactly once. Do not run file IO, trace finalization, shell/PID check or another tool between final CUA observation and summary.
steps.post_summary: Independently verify original owned PID/full argv; if it remains, SIGTERM only that proven exact owned process and confirm absence. No other process or app is affected.

action_counting.non_navigation: Count launch, getApp, every app input/observation outside N2, screenshots and close/Discard/confirmation within 20; keep capacity for cleanup.
action_counting.navigation: N2 Tab and its fresh full AX read form one separately tracked search step, maximum 40 pairs. N3 blur Tab is counted as a non-navigation input.
action_counting.excluded: Recorder/file IO, summary-only CUA completion call and independent process proof are not UI actions.
action_counting.budget: Reserve time for cleanup; when any cap approaches, stop the calibration, retain actual failure state if allowed by budget, then cleanup.

evidence.raw_AX: Persist full returned AX privately, including each navigation state; emit only focus line/value, rev, piece count and status.
evidence.screenshots: 2–3 actual own-app images, unedited; no other app or desktop/personal browser capture. Early stop may retain fewer images if capture itself would exceed a bound.
evidence.trace: Paired before/returned records with UTC and monotonic times. Persist the focus sequence and both exact-value checks.
evidence.provenance: Bind plan, proposal, SOURCE87, gate receipts, unique bundle and byte-exact executable.
evidence.outcome: Report failures and unknowns without diagnosing cause from the unsuccessful earlier route.
